description:
## Problem
K9 in `docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md` records that the bundled TPC-DS `dsdgen` numbers `s_purchase`, `s_catalog_order` and `s_web_order` ids from 1 in every refresh set, overlapping base keys. Because of that, maintenance refuses to run on DuckDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite when a maintenance target table has a primary key (owner decision 2026-11-06 on `tpcds-maintenance-dsdgen-refresh-data-20261103`: keep the kit's keys unchanged).

K9 says "The 4.0.0 source is not available here" and identifies the cause from the public tpcds-kit. The 4.0.0 source is now available (TPC download; rebuild steps in `_sources/tpc-ds/REBUILD.md`), and it has the same defect: `getUpdateBase(int nTable)` in `tools/scaling.c` returns `arRowcount[nTable - S_BRAND].kNextInsertValue`, while `setUpdateScaling` writes `arRowcount[nTable].kNextInsertValue`. That K9 sentence is now stale.

## Decision gate (owner)
Choose one before any code change:
- **A. Keep the kit's keys** (status quo). Only update the K9 text to say the 4.0.0 source confirms the cause.
- **B. Patch dsdgen at the root** (new tracked patch under `_sources/tpc-ds/`, all six platforms rebuilt), so refresh keys continue after the base maximum; then lift the primary-key refusal.
Option B changes refresh-set keys for every scale and seed, so maintenance results before and after are not comparable. The owner must also decide how results record the change (for example a new maintenance method or datagen version), so regression lookbacks never compare across it.

## Guardrails
- No BenchBox-side rewriting or filtering of refresh rows; any key fix goes into dsdgen as a tracked patch (owner rejected loader workarounds for dsdgen defects on 2026-11-20).
- Base data must stay byte-identical: SF 0.01 and SF 1 base tables before and after, seed 20260709.
- Rebuild all six platforms together and regenerate `benchbox/_binaries/SHA256MANIFEST.json` (procedure in `docs/internal/tpc-binary-release.md`).
- Do not lift the primary-key refusal unless option B has landed and its acceptance is met.

## Verification rubric
- Option A: K9 text names the 4.0.0 source, file and function; the comment-policy and docs checks pass.
- Option B: for SF 0.01 and SF 1, refresh sets 1-4, every refresh order/ticket id exceeds the base maximum of its table; base data is unchanged; DuckDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite run all 11 maintenance functions with primary keys enforced; result metadata distinguishes the new key scheme.
